newsitem.title: UK: Siebe offers 46 mln stg for Whessoe.
newsitem.headline: Siebe offers 46 mln stg for Whessoe.

text.p: Britain's Siebe Plc said on Wednesday it had agreed on a cash offer of around 46 million stg for the entire issued share capital of instrumentations and controls firm Whessoe plc.
Siebe said it was offering 155 pence for each Whessoe share. A share alternative would also be available at 31 new Siebe shares for every 200 Whessoe shares.
Whessoe's board has given its unanimous backing to the offer.

"The acquisition... not only offers shareholders a substantial premium... but also the opportunity for Whessoe's operating businesses to benefit from being a part of the larger Siebe Grop," George Duncan, Whessoes's chairman said.
Whessoe was up 65-1/2 pence at 155-1/2 in moderate trade of 34,687 shares 45 minutes before close of Wednesday's trade.
